skills.name: 伪诚
skills.text: 当你交给其他角色手牌后，或你的手牌被其他角色获得后，若你的手牌数小于体力值，你可以摸一张牌。
notes: Trigger weicheng/hand-transfer-draw: cardsMoved with movementOccurrence perOwnerSourceHandGain over sourceZones hand — one candidate per movement of an owner hand card into another living character's hand, which covers both clauses (a give and a take by another character are the same physical movement shape).
The compare condition (currentHandCount lessThan currentHp) is evaluated at window capture, i.e. after the transfer and before the draw; the generic draw op draws one.
The existing perOwnerSourceHandGain boundary (introduced for Yi Ji's Jiyuan) expresses the whole trigger, so no new TriggerFactKind, window or schema node was needed.

skills.name: 盗书
skills.text: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以选择一种花色，获得其他角色的一张手牌。若此牌与你选择的花色：相同，你对其造成1点伤害且此技能视为未发动过；不同，你交给该角色一张其他花色的手牌（若没有需展示所有手牌）。
notes: Activation daoshu-guess: play-phase activation, usesPerTurn 1, one activation-level target of kind otherLivingWithHand; the bespoke op daoshuGuessAndTake (7172) runs the whole settlement.

Suit prompt: four public suit options (spade/heart/club/diamond); the take rides the blind-hand privacy shape (random concealed hand card, two processing hops, seats-only public evidence). The suit comparison reads the card's effective suit inside the owner's hand per the BWIKI FAQ.

Same suit: the per-turn ledger _programUses[(owner, skill, activation)] is decremented so the activation is immediately available again this phase (BWIKI FAQ: repeated correct guesses may repeat), then the 1 damage settles through BeginProgramSkillDamage which resumes and completes the frame.

Different suit: the owner picks one hand card whose effective suit differs from the taken card's suit (BWIKI FAQ: 'other suit' is relative to the obtained card, not the declared suit); without one the whole hand is bound into a public card set and revealed through ProgramCardsRevealedEvent.

ProgramDaoshuEvent records owner, target, declared suit, whether a card was taken, the branch and the public give-back/reveal ids; the taken card's identity stays out of the event and of ordinary snapshots.

observations: BWIKI matches the coordinator-locked wording verbatim for both skills, the title 锋镝悬信, wei male 3HP (经典体力=3) and the 2019-09-02 荟萃-计将安出 release; no textual divergence.

BWIKI FAQ clarifies '盗书'的'其他花色'是与获得的牌不同的花色 — the give-back suit is judged against the TAKEN card's suit, not the declared suit. The coordinator hint suggested 相对所选花色; the implemented rule follows the BWIKI FAQ reading and only differs from the hint when the given card would carry the declared suit (legal here, forbidden there).

BWIKI FAQ also fixes the comparison basis: 花色是否一致均以在蒋干手牌中的花色判断 — the taken card's effective suit inside the owner's hand decides the branch; the give-back eligibility uses the same effective-suit basis for the owner's hand cards.

盗书's own take does NOT trigger 伪诚: the taken card moves from the target's hand (not the owner's), and the perOwnerSourceHandGain boundary only fires for movements whose source is the owner's hand. The give-back branch does trigger 伪诚, once per given card, through the shared cards-moved window that opens after the give movement.

The activation-level target selection precedes the suit declaration (engine convention for active-skill targets); the real game's wording suggests suit-first, which is a cosmetic ordering difference with identical legality.
New bespoke op 7172 daoshuGuessAndTake only; no new TriggerFactKind, PlayerMarkerKind, ConditionKind, trigger window or schema node; weicheng reuses the generic compare condition and draw op.
共享口径：'获得其他角色的一张手牌'按随机取得一张暗手牌执行（同突袭/冲阵/诱敌隐私口径），牌面只对结算可见，公开证据只含座位与数量。
